text: Travel experiences can change us in many ways. When planning a trip, I always search for interesting places to visit. Meeting new cultures is exciting because people live differently around the world. I love trying local food, although sometimes it is too spicy for me! Language barriers can be difficult, and I often use hand gestures to communicate. Once, I got lost in a small town because I couldn't ask for directions. Despite these challenges, travel creates wonderful memories that stay with us forever.
